# Purpose

This report evaluates the peaks-over-threshold (POT) event datasets before non-stationary Generalized Pareto modelling. The objective is to determine whether the provisional P97.5 threshold with three-day runs declustering provides an appropriate bias-variance compromise, while retaining P95 and P99 and two- and five-day run lengths as formal sensitivities.

The primary P97.5 quality-controlled dataset retains rainfall element quality codes 0 to 4. Element quality codes 6 to 9 are rejected from the primary tail analysis; code 5 is retained only in a broader sensitivity analysis. Record-level observation quality flags are not treated as direct rainfall-quality flags.

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(data.table)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

project_root <- if (file.exists("_targets.R")) {
  "."
} else if (file.exists("../_targets.R")) {
  ".."
} else {
  stop("Could not locate project root containing _targets.R.", call. = FALSE)
}

pot_dir <- file.path(project_root, "data-derived", "rainfall", "pot")
pot_table_dir <- file.path(project_root, "tables", "rainfall_pot")
out_dir <- file.path(project_root, "tables", "rainfall_pot_diagnostics")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

all_events_file <- file.path(
  pot_dir,
  "rainfall_pot_events_all_thresholds_runs_1950_2025.parquet"
)

p975_file <- file.path(
  pot_dir,
  "rainfall_pot_events_p975_run3_1950_2025.parquet"
)

p975_primary_file <- file.path(
  pot_dir,
  "rainfall_pot_events_p975_run3_primary_qc_1950_2025.parquet"
)

threshold_file <- file.path(
  pot_dir,
  "rainfall_pot_thresholds_1961_1990.parquet"
)

required_files <- c(all_events_file, p975_file, threshold_file)
missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Required POT products are missing:\n",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n"),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

all_events <- as.data.table(read_parquet(all_events_file))
p975_all <- as.data.table(read_parquet(p975_file))
thresholds <- as.data.table(read_parquet(threshold_file))

if (file.exists(p975_primary_file)) {
  p975_primary <- as.data.table(read_parquet(p975_primary_file))
} else {
  p975_primary <- p975_all[
    rainfall_quality_peak %in% c(0L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L)
  ]
}

p975_broad <- p975_all[
  rainfall_quality_peak %in% c(0L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L)
]

# Stable plotting labels.
all_events[, threshold_label_plot := factor(
  threshold_id,
  levels = c("p95", "p975", "p99"),
  labels = c("P95", "P97.5", "P99")
)]

all_events[, run_label := factor(
  run_length_days,
  levels = c(2L, 3L, 5L),
  labels = c("2-day run", "3-day run", "5-day run")
)]

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11))
```

# Declustering sensitivity

```{r}
#| label: declustering-summary

decluster_summary <- all_events[
  ,
  .(
    events =
      as.integer(.N),

    stations =
      as.integer(
        uniqueN(station_number)
      ),

    median_peak_mm =
      as.numeric(
        median(
          event_peak_mm,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      ),

    median_excess_mm =
      as.numeric(
        median(
          excess_mm,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      ),

    median_duration_days =
      as.numeric(
        median(
          event_duration_days,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      ),

    multi_exceedance_fraction =
      as.numeric(
        mean(
          n_exceedance_days > 1L,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      )
  ),
  by = .(
    threshold_label_plot,
    run_length_days
  )
]

run2 <- decluster_summary[
  run_length_days == 2L,
  .(
    threshold_label_plot,
    events_run2 =
      as.integer(events)
  )
]

decluster_summary <- merge(
  decluster_summary,
  run2,
  by = "threshold_label_plot",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

decluster_summary[
  ,
  event_reduction_vs_run2_pct :=
    as.numeric(
      100 *
        (
          events_run2 -
          events
        ) /
        events_run2
    )
]

data.table::setorder(
  decluster_summary,
  threshold_label_plot,
  run_length_days
)

decluster_summary
```

# Mean residual life diagnostics

For a generalized Pareto tail above a sufficiently high threshold, the mean excess above threshold should be approximately linear as the threshold increases. Because station rainfall climates vary greatly, diagnostics are calculated on station-normalized threshold levels rather than on a single national millimetre threshold.

```{r}
#| label: mrl-data

# Use the raw P95 run-3 event peaks. These contain enough tail depth to evaluate
# progressively higher station-relative thresholds.
p95_events <- all_events[
  threshold_id == "p95" &
  run_length_days == 3L &
  rainfall_quality_peak %in% c(0L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L)
]

# Fractional positions between each station's P95 and the upper observed tail.
# P97.5 and P99 remain the main formal thresholds; this grid is diagnostic.
diag_probs <- c(.95, .96, .97, .975, .98, .985, .99)

# Build station-specific diagnostic thresholds directly from event peaks.
# At .95 the stored P95 threshold is used. Higher levels use empirical quantiles
# of eligible P95 event peaks, providing a stability diagnostic rather than a new
# climatological threshold definition.
station_mrl <- rbindlist(lapply(diag_probs, function(prob) {
  p95_events[, {
    u <- if (abs(prob - .95) < 1e-10) {
      first(threshold_mm)
    } else {
      as.numeric(quantile(event_peak_mm, prob =
        (prob - .95) / (1 - .95), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
    }
    exc <- event_peak_mm[event_peak_mm > u] - u
    list(
      diagnostic_probability = prob,
      diagnostic_threshold_mm = u,
      exceedances = length(exc),
      mean_excess_mm = if (length(exc) > 0L) mean(exc) else NA_real_
    )
  }, by = .(station_number, station_name, state)]
}))

mrl_summary <- station_mrl[, .(
  stations = uniqueN(station_number),
  median_exceedances = median(exceedances),
  median_threshold_mm = median(diagnostic_threshold_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_mean_excess_mm = median(mean_excess_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
  q25_mean_excess_mm = quantile(mean_excess_mm, .25, na.rm = TRUE),
  q75_mean_excess_mm = quantile(mean_excess_mm, .75, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = diagnostic_probability]

mrl_summary
```

```{r}
  geom_line(linewidth = .8) +
```

# Station-level GPD parameter stability

This section uses a lightweight maximum-likelihood GPD fit to inspect whether scale and shape estimates remain reasonably stable between P95, P97.5 and P99. These are diagnostics only. They are not the final hierarchical/non-stationary GPD models.

```{r}
#| label: gpd-functions

gpd_nll <- function(par, excess) {
  log_scale <- par[1]
  shape <- par[2]
  scale <- exp(log_scale)

  if (!is.finite(scale) || scale <= 0) return(Inf)

  if (abs(shape) < 1e-7) {
    return(length(excess) * log(scale) + sum(excess) / scale)
  }

  z <- 1 + shape * excess / scale
  if (any(z <= 0) || any(!is.finite(z))) return(Inf)

  length(excess) * log(scale) +
    (1 / shape + 1) * sum(log(z))
}

fit_gpd_quick <- function(excess) {

  excess <- as.numeric(
    excess[
      is.finite(excess) &
        excess > 0
    ]
  )


  if (length(excess) < 20L) {

    return(
      list(
        scale =
          NA_real_,

        shape =
          NA_real_,

        convergence =
          NA_integer_
      )
    )
  }


  start_scale <- as.numeric(
    max(
      mean(excess),
      0.1
    )
  )


  fit <- tryCatch(

    stats::optim(
      par = c(
        log(start_scale),
        0.1
      ),
      fn = gpd_nll,
      excess = excess,
      method = "Nelder-Mead",
      control = list(
        maxit = 3000L
      )
    ),

    error = function(e) {
      NULL
    }
  )


  if (is.null(fit)) {

    return(
      list(
        scale =
          NA_real_,

        shape =
          NA_real_,

        convergence =
          99L
      )
    )
  }


  list(
    scale =
      as.numeric(
        exp(
          fit$par[1]
        )
      ),

    shape =
      as.numeric(
        fit$par[2]
      ),

    convergence =
      as.integer(
        fit$convergence
      )
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: gpd-stability

run3_primary_quality <- all_events[
  run_length_days == 3L &
    rainfall_quality_peak %in%
      c(
        0L,
        1L,
        2L,
        3L,
        4L
      )
]

gpd_station_stability <- run3_primary_quality[
  ,
  {

    fit <- fit_gpd_quick(
      excess_mm
    )

    list(
      events =
        as.integer(.N),

      scale_mm =
        as.numeric(
          fit$scale
        ),

      shape =
        as.numeric(
          fit$shape
        ),

      convergence =
        as.integer(
          fit$convergence
        )
    )
  },
  by = .(
    station_number,
    station_name,
    state,
    threshold_id,
    threshold_label_plot
  )
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Valid diagnostic fits only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gpd_station_stability[
  ,
  fit_valid :=
    convergence == 0L &
    is.finite(scale_mm) &
    is.finite(shape) &
    scale_mm > 0
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary by threshold
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gpd_stability_summary <-
  gpd_station_stability[
    fit_valid == TRUE,
    .(
      stations_fitted =
        as.integer(.N),

      median_events =
        as.numeric(
          median(
            events,
            na.rm = TRUE
          )
        ),

      median_scale_mm =
        as.numeric(
          median(
            scale_mm,
            na.rm = TRUE
          )
        ),

      q25_scale_mm =
        as.numeric(
          quantile(
            scale_mm,
            0.25,
            na.rm = TRUE,
            names = FALSE
          )
        ),

      q75_scale_mm =
        as.numeric(
          quantile(
            scale_mm,
            0.75,
            na.rm = TRUE,
            names = FALSE
          )
        ),

      median_shape =
        as.numeric(
          median(
            shape,
            na.rm = TRUE
          )
        ),

      q25_shape =
        as.numeric(
          quantile(
            shape,
            0.25,
            na.rm = TRUE,
            names = FALSE
          )
        ),

      q75_shape =
        as.numeric(
          quantile(
            shape,
            0.75,
            na.rm = TRUE,
            names = FALSE
          )
        ),

      shape_negative_fraction =
        as.numeric(
          mean(
            shape < 0,
            na.rm = TRUE
          )
        ),

      shape_positive_fraction =
        as.numeric(
          mean(
            shape > 0,
            na.rm = TRUE
          )
        )
    ),
    by = .(
      threshold_id,
      threshold_label_plot
    )
  ]

gpd_stability_summary[
  ,
  threshold_order :=
    match(
      threshold_id,
      c(
        "p95",
        "p975",
        "p99"
      )
    )
]

data.table::setorder(
  gpd_stability_summary,
  threshold_order
)

gpd_stability_summary[
  ,
  threshold_order := NULL
]

gpd_stability_summary
```

```{r}
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, quantile(gpd_station_stability$scale_mm, .95, na.rm = TRUE))) +
  labs(title = "GPD scale stability", x = NULL, y = "Scale (mm)")

p1
```

# Decision framework

The primary threshold should satisfy all of the following:

1. a sufficiently high threshold for plausible generalized Pareto tail behaviour;
2. stable scale and shape estimates as threshold increases;
3. adequate independent event counts across most or all stations;
4. limited sensitivity to reasonable declustering run lengths;
5. limited sensitivity to rainfall-element quality filtering;
6. sufficient sample size for subsequent spatial/non-stationary modelling.

P97.5 is the provisional primary threshold because it retains substantially more information than P99 while being appreciably deeper into the tail than P95. The diagnostics above determine whether that provisional choice is retained.

# Next phase

Once the threshold is fixed, the next model sequence is:

1. stationary pooled/structured GPD benchmark;
2. time-varying GPD scale with initially common/strongly pooled shape;
3. explicit exceedance-rate model combined with the GPD magnitude model;
4. early-versus-recent return-level comparison;
5. threshold and declustering sensitivity;
6. spatial dependence and joint-extreme diagnostics.
